mapper.select: SELECT t1.corp_gr , t1.fund_cd , t1.fund_nm , t1.bf_gyul_ymd + 1 AS bf_ymd , t1.af_gyul_ymd AS af_gyul_ymd , t1.mg_cd AS sec_cd FROM SZM0IA t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.fund_cd IN (SELECT fund_cd FROM SHM0HM_CHUI ta WHERE corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND ymd = #{ymd}) AND t1.fst_seolj_ymd <= #{ymd} AND #{dw} = 'd_ja020r2h' UNION ALL SELECT t1.corp_gr , t1.fund_cd , t1.fund_nm , t1.bf_gyul_ymd + 1 AS bf_ymd , t1.af_gyul_ymd AS af_gyul_ymd , t1.mg_cd AS sec_cd FROM SZM0IA t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.fund_cd IN (SELECT fund_cd FROM SCM0CM_CHUI ta WHERE corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND ymd = #{ymd}) AND t1.fst_seolj_ymd <= #{ymd} AND #{dw} = 'd_ja020r2c' UNION ALL SELECT t1.corp_gr , t1.fund_cd , t1.fund_nm , t1.bf_gyul_ymd + 1 AS bf_ymd , t1.af_gyul_ymd AS af_gyul_ymd , t1.mg_cd AS sec_cd FROM SZM0IA t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.fund_cd IN (SELECT fund_cd FROM SJM0JM_CHUI ta WHERE corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND ymd = #{ymd}) AND t1.fst_seolj_ymd <= #{ymd} AND #{dw} = 'd_ja020r2j' ORDER BY sec_cd ASC, fund_nm ASC, fund_cd ASC

SELECT t1.corp_gr , t1.ymd AS ymd , t1.fund_cd , t1.jm_cd , t1.buy_date , cj.cj_nm AS jm_nm , NVL(t1.bfil_aekm, 0) AS bfil_aekm , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek, 0) AS bfil_chui_aek , NVL(t1.alter_aek, 0) AS alter_aek , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.alter_aek, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek, 0) - NVL(t1.alter_aek, 0) END AS cha_aek , t1.ip_user FROM SCM0CM_CHUI t1 , SCM0CJ cj WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = #{ymd} AND t1.fund_cd = #{fundCd} AND cj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND cj.jm_cd = t1.jm_cd ORDER BY t1.jm_cd ASC, t1.buy_date ASC

SELECT t1.corp_gr , t1.ymd AS ymd , t1.fund_cd , t1.jm_cd , hj.hj_nm AS jm_nm , NVL(t1.bfil_aekm, 0) AS bfil_aekm , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek, 0) AS bfil_chui_aek , NVL(t1.alter_aek, 0) AS alter_aek , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.alter_aek, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE NVL(t1.alter_aek, 0) - NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek, 0) END AS cha_aek , t1.ip_user FROM SHM0HM_CHUI t1 , SHM0HJ hj WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = #{ymd} AND t1.fund_cd = #{fundCd} AND hj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND hj.jm_cd = t1.jm_cd ORDER BY t1.jm_cd ASC

SELECT t1.corp_gr , t1.ymd AS ymd , t1.fund_cd , t1.jm_cd , t1.type_trench , t1.bs_type , jj.jj_nm AS jm_nm , NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu, 0) AS bfil_boyu_jusu , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek, 0) AS bfil_chui_aek , NVL(t1.alter_aek, 0) AS alter_aek , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.alter_aek, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek, 0) - NVL(t1.alter_aek, 0) END AS cha_aek , t1.ip_user FROM SJM0JM_CHUI t1 , SJM0JJ jj WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = #{ymd} AND t1.fund_cd = #{fundCd} AND jj.jm_cd = t1.jm_cd ORDER BY t1.jm_cd ASC
